name: print-social-indigo-carousel-slide-follow-organizers-with-profile-screen
title: Follow Organizers Slide with Profile Screen
whatItIs: The next indigo slide with the headline 'Follow Organizers: Get notified first. Be first, always!', a phone in a yellow frame showing an organizer profile with a Following pill, social icons and upcoming event, and a large smiling portrait in a yellow-ringed circle cropped at the top right.
whatItMeans: A repeated layout with a new screen and a new face makes a series feel consistent and human.
techniques: Same frame and headline system as the previous slide
Portrait circle cropped by the canvas edge
Profile screen shown in a phone
Repeated site name at the base

vocabulary.definition: A repeated layout across the slides of a carousel.
A portrait cut by the edge of the frame.
A button state showing that the user follows an account.
